name.en: Concert tickets: “pay the transfer fee first”

how.en: You find someone selling tickets to a sold-out concert on Facebook or TikTok, and the chat moves to WhatsApp. They mention well-known ticketing outlets, take your payment and then ask for more money for a “transfer”, “authorisation” or “name-change” fee. No tickets arrive.

text.en: Someone offers tickets to a popular concert on Facebook or TikTok.
They mention real ticketing outlets to seem genuine.
After you pay, they ask for transfer, authorisation or name-change fees.
Payment received thanks! Ticketek just needs a $120 name-change fee before I can transfer the tickets to you. Can you send it now so they don’t cancel them?

en: Tickets sold through social media or private chats.
Extra fees after you already paid.
Buy only from the official seller or its authorised resale.
Don’t pay extra fees to “release” tickets.
If you paid, contact your bank straight away.

sources.title: Media update: When the shopfront is a scam
